evidence: Modifies test/functional/p2p_tx_download.py, which tests p2p transaction relay and download behavior.
rationale: Fixes an intermittent failure in p2p_tx_download.py caused by nodes[1] lacking mocktime during test_block_inv. When wall-clock time advanced before nodes[0] delivered an announcement, nodes[1] requested from an unresponsive test peer and caused sync_mempools() to fail.
